name: Aswang
description: The aswang is an umbrella term for a complex of shape-shifting evil creatures in Filipino folklore — among the most feared supernatural beings in the Philippines — that live as ordinary humans by day and become predatory monsters by night.

aliases.name: Manananggal
aliases.meaning: That which separates itself — refers to the self-segmenting viscera-sucker variant

aliases.name: Tik-Tik
aliases.meaning: Named for the ticking sound the creature makes; sound grows louder when the creature is far away and softer when close

aliases.name: Wak-Wak
aliases.meaning: Named for a bird-like cry; a variant that appears as a bird at night

aliases.name: Sigbin
aliases.meaning: A nocturnal creature variant said to walk backward

aliases.name: Asuang
aliases.meaning: Variant spelling and regional pronunciation; connected to the evil god Asuang in Bicol origin stories

origin: Aswang belief is widespread across the Philippine archipelago, with the highest concentration of tradition in the Visayas region, particularly the province of Capiz in Panay Island (historically called the 'aswang capital'). Variants are also prominent in southern Luzon and parts of Mindanao.
